currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a Skill Gem to apply it. Can only apply to Skill Gems with fewer than 5 Support Gem Sockets.

currencies.name: Artificer's Orb
currencies.description: Adds an [Augment] Socket to a [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon], wand, staff or Armour
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a Martial Weapon, wand, staff or Armour to apply it.

currencies.name: Divine Orb
currencies.description: Randomises the numeric values of modifiers on an item
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an item to apply it.

currencies.name: Blessed Orb
currencies.description: Randomises the numeric values of the implicit modifiers of an item
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click another item to apply it.

currencies.name: Sacred Orb
currencies.description: Randomises the numeric values of base defences on an armour
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an armour to apply it.

currencies.name: Scroll Fragment

currencies.name: Alchemy Shard

currencies.name: Chance Shard

currencies.name: Eternal Orb
currencies.description: Creates an imprint of an item for later restoration. The imprint can't be applied to Fractured Items
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on an item to create an imprint. This imprint can later be used to restore this specific item to that imprinted state.

currencies.name: Imprint
currencies.description: Restores an imprinted item onto the original. Can't be applied to Fractured Items
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on the imprinted original item to restore its modifiers. An imprint cannot be dropped or traded to other players.

currencies.name: Vaal Orb
currencies.description: Modifies an item unpredictably and [Corrupted|Corrupts] it
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an item to corrupt it. Corrupted items cannot be modified again.

currencies.name: Architect's Orb
currencies.description: Modifies a [Corrupted] [Equipment] or [Jewel] item unpredictably or destroys it
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on a corrupted item to apply it.

currencies.name: Crystallised Corruption
currencies.description: Modifies a [Corrupted] Skill Gem unpredictably or destroys it
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on a corrupted gem to apply it.

currencies.name: Core Destabiliser

currencies.name: Ancient Infuser

currencies.name: Vaal Cultivation Orb
currencies.description:
Replaces up to 2 modifiers on a [Corrupted] [UniqueCulture|Vaal Unique]
Replaces other [ItemRarity|Uniques] with a Corrupted Unique of the same Item Class
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on a unique item to apply it.

Improves the [Quality|quality] of an [Armour],
exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of [Corrupted|Corrupting] it
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an armour to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.

currencies.name: Vaal Blacksmith's Infuser
currencies.description:
Improves the [Quality|quality] of a [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon],
exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of [Corrupted|Corrupting] it
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a martial weapon to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.

currencies.name: Vaal Arcanist's Infuser

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a wand, staff or sceptre to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.

currencies.name: Vaal Catalysing Infuser

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a ring or amulet to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.

currencies.name: Orb of Extraction

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on an item containing socketed [Augment|Augments] to apply it.

currencies.name: Vaal Siphoner
currencies.description:
Adds a kill threshold to a [Corrupted] [ItemRarity|Rare] [Jewellery] item, when threshold is met
[VaalSiphoner|Siphons] a random modifier and improves the numeric values of other modifiers
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on a corrupted rare jewellery item to apply it.

currencies.name: Awakener's Orb
currencies.description:
Destroys an item, applying its influence to another of the same item class
The second item is reforged as a rare item with both influence types and new modifiers
currencies.directions: Right click this item, then left click the item you wish to take the influence from, then left click an item of the same item class you wish to apply it to.

currencies.name: Rogue's Marker

Creates a portal to the Rogue Harbour from a Town or Hideout
Used as Currency for services in the Rogue Harbour
currencies.directions: Right click on this item while in a Town or Hideout to use it.

currencies.name: Ritual Splinter
currencies.directions: Combine 100 Splinters to create a Ritual Vessel.

currencies.name: Ritual Vessel
currencies.description: Stores the monsters slain for the first time from a completed Ritual Altar for future use
currencies.directions: Right-click this item then left-click a Ritual Altar to store the monsters from the completed Ritual in this item. Cannot be used on a Ritual in a map opened with a Blood-Filled Vessel.

currencies.name: Orb of Dominance
currencies.description: Removes one Influenced Modifier from an item with at least two Influenced Modifiers and upgrades another Influenced Modifier. Upgrading a modifier of the highest tier transforms the modifier into an Elevated Modifier. Attempting to upgrade an Elevated Modifier rerolls its values. Can be used on Body Armours, Boots, Gloves and Helmets.
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an item with at least two Influenced Modifiers to apply it.

currencies.name: Blood-filled Vessel
currencies.directions: Can be used in a personal Map Device alongside a Map to add the monsters stored from a previous Ritual Altar to a Ritual Altar in that Map.

currencies.name: Enkindling Orb

Quality.definition:
Quality grants small bonuses to an item depending on the type of item, up to a default maximum of 20%.

[MartialWeapon|Martial Weapons] gain 1% more [Physical] damage per Quality.
Armours gain 1% more [Armour], [Evasion], [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and [Ward|Runic Ward] per Quality.
Rings and Amulets have a number of possible quality types that provide bonuses to specific modifiers on the item.
[Flask|Flasks] gain 1% more Life and Mana recovery per Quality.
[Charm|Charms] gain 1% increased duration per Quality.
Skill Gems or equipment that grant Skills grant a specific bonus to their Skill based on their Quality.

Sanctified.definition:
Sanctifying an item will multiply the values of an items modifiers by a random value ranging from 78% to 122% for each modifier. The resulting item will now be Sanctified.
Most methods of item crafting and modification cannot be used on Sanctified items.

Abyssalify.definition:
Desecrating an item adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier. If modifiers are full then a random modifier is also removed. These modifiers can be revealed at the Well of Souls.

Items with Desecrated Modifiers cannot be Desecrated again.

MarkofAbyssalLord.definition: [Abyssalify|Desecrating] an item with the Mark of the Abyssal Lord modifier always removes that modifier, replacing it with an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier of a higher tier.
